title: MSPred: Hierarchical Video Prediction at Multiple Scales
description: A model for forecasting future outcomes at different spatial and temporal levels of granularity.
body: Our work, MSPred: Video Prediction at Multiple Spatio-Temporal Scales with Hierarchical Recurrent Networks, was accepted for publication at the 33rd British Machine Vision Conference.
MSPred predicts future video frames and high-level representations at several spatial and temporal scales.
